Page            8 KB, the unit of I/O

caption: SQL Server always reads and writes whole pages.

steps.label: Logical read
steps.sub: page already cached in the buffer pool — cheap

steps.label: Physical read
steps.sub: page not cached, must come from disk — expensive

steps.label: Dirty page
steps.sub: modified in memory, not yet written to disk

steps.label: Checkpoint
steps.sub: writes dirty pages to disk, shortens crash recovery

steps.label: Lazy writer
steps.sub: evicts unused pages to free buffer pool memory
